semantics.function: pos is the smallest index i in 0..7 for which in[i] is 1; if in is zero, pos is zero.
semantics.timing: Pure combinational behavior; output follows current input after combinational settling, with no clock or cycle latency.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.priority: Bit 0 has highest priority; bit 7 has lowest priority.

numeric.output_range: Unsigned indices 0 through 7 encoded in 3 bits.
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic accumulation, rounding, truncation, saturation, or overflow. Zero input and bit-0-first input both encode as zero.

verification.compile: Icarus v12 with -g2012, warnings, explicit dev_tb top, finite timeout.
verification.oracle: For each binary input, independently scan indices from 7 down to 0 and overwrite expected on each set bit, leaving the smallest index. Default expected is zero.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 256 binary inputs in ascending and descending order, checking after settling to exercise input changes and reveal stale outputs. Includes zero, all one-hot inputs, all ones and the given example.
verification.comparison: Use case inequality and fatal mismatch; emit explicit PASS only after all checks.
verification.simulation: Matching vvp with finite shell timeout and testbench watchdog.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X or Z input bits is unspecified; verification and functional guarantees cover binary inputs only.
